section-36-5.TO: for the purpose of this section, be used in determining the amount of assistance
section-36-5.IF: minimal financial assistance is provided in cash

section-36-5.TO: for the purpose of this section, be determined by reference to the gross cash equivalent of the assistance
section-36-5.IF: minimal financial assistance is provided otherwise than in cash

section-37-1.TO: give to the enterprise a minimal financial assistance notification

section-37-3.ONLY AFTER: it has received the confirmation referred to in subsection (2)(c)

section-37-4.TO: provide to the enterprise a minimal financial assistance confirmation

section-37-6.TO: keep a written record detailing— (a) that it has received a subsidy by way of minimal financial assistance, (b) the date on which it was given, and (c) the gross value amount of the assistance

section-37-7.TO: be kept for at least three years beginning with the date mentioned in paragraph (b) of that subsection

section-39-1.TO: give to the enterprise a SPEI assistance notification

section-39-3.ONLY AFTER: it has received the confirmation referred to in subsection (2)(c)

section-39-4.TO: provide to the enterprise a SPEI assistance confirmation

section-39-6.TO: keep a written record detailing— (a) that it has received a subsidy by way of SPEI assistance, (b) the date on which it was given, and (c) the gross value amount of the assistance

section-39-7.TO: be kept for at least three years beginning with the date mentioned in paragraph (b) of that subsection

section-41-2.TO: For the purposes of subsection (1), be used in determining the amount of the assistance
For the purposes of subsection (1), be determined by reference to the gross cash equivalent of the assistance
section-41-2.IF: assistance is provided otherwise than in cash

section-42-1.TO: by regulations— (a) amend section 36(1), 38(1) or 41(1) so as to substitute a different amount for the amount specified; (b) provide for a lower amount to apply, instead of an amount specified in section 36(1), 38(1) or 41(1), in the case of particular descriptions of subsidy; (c) amend section 36(4) or 38(4) so as to substitute a different amount for the amount specified; (d) provide for a different amount to apply, instead of an amount specified in section 36(4) or 38(4), in the case of particular descriptions of subsidy

section-42-2.FOR: The power to make regulations under subsection (1)(a)
section-42-2.TO: be exercised so as to substitute a higher amount for the purpose of securing that the amount specified in sterling is up to an equivalent of— (a) 325,000 special drawing rights, in the case of the amount specified in section 36(1); (b) 750,000 special drawing rights, in the case of the amount specified in section 38(1); (c) 15,000,000 special drawing rights, in the case of the amount specified in section 41(1)

section-42-2.FOR: The amount determined as a result of the currency conversion carried out for this purpose
section-42-2.TO: be rounded up or down to such convenient number as the Secretary of State thinks appropriate

section-42-4.FOR: An amount specified in regulations under subsection (1)(c) or (d) which amend section 36(4)
section-42-4.TO: exceed the amount specified in section 36(1)

section-42-5.FOR: An amount specified in regulations under subsection (1)(c) or (d) which amend section 38(4)
section-42-5.TO: exceed the amount specified in section 38(1)

section-43-3.TO: be given in respect of a natural disaster, or another exceptional occurrence, in reliance on the exemption under this section
section-43-3.ONLY IF: — (a) a notice is published by the Secretary of State for the purposes of this section declaring that the exemption applies in respect of that natural disaster or occurrence, and (b) that notice has not been withdrawn by the publication of a further notice

section-43-4.FOR: A copy of a notice under this section

section-44-3.TO: be given in respect of a national or global economic emergency in reliance on the exemption under this section
section-44-3.ONLY IF: — (a) a notice is published by the Secretary of State for the purposes of this section declaring that the exemption applies in respect of that emergency, and (b) that notice has not been withdrawn by the publication of a further notice

section-44-4.FOR: A copy of a notice under this section
